South Dakota.authority: South Dakota Department of Revenue / Deadwood Chamber / National Indian Gaming Commission
South Dakota.note: Twenty-six destination casino properties: eighteen deduplicated Deadwood casino destinations plus eight tribal casino destinations physically in South Dakota. Rosebud Casino is excluded here because its physical property is in Nebraska and is already cataloged there.

North Dakota.authority: North Dakota Attorney General / National Indian Gaming Commission
North Dakota.note: Five Indian casino destinations inspected under the state's tribal gaming oversight: Dakota Magic, Spirit Lake, 4 Bears, Sky Dancer, and Prairie Knights.
